name: AWS Braket: Optimize (SPSA)
description: Calls the quantum algorithm sidecar to run one stateless SPSA optimizer step (POST /optimize). Returns either updated circuit parameters for the next iteration or a convergence signal. Part of the AWS Braket Algorithm Accelerator pattern — required for variational algorithms (QAOA, VQE).

properties.label: Optimize URL
properties.description: Full URL of the sidecar's /optimize endpoint. The default FEEL expression appends the path to the sidecarUrl process variable.

properties.label: Request Body (FEEL)
properties.description: FEEL object sent as the optimizer request body. current_params holds the variational parameters just evaluated; objective_value is the scalar cost from /process-results; best_bitstring is the best measurement outcome so far; optimizer_state is the opaque state blob returned by the previous call (set to {} on the first iteration).
properties.value: = {algorithm: "spsa", iteration: if iteration != null then iteration else 0, problem: problem, current_params: currentParams, objective_value: objectiveValue, best_bitstring: currentBestBitstring, optimizer_state: if optimizerState != null then optimizerState else {}, hyperparams: {max_iterations: if maxIterations != null then maxIterations else 30}}

properties.label: Result Variable
properties.description: Process variable to store the raw sidecar HTTP response

properties.label: Result Expression
properties.description: Maps the sidecar response to process variables. converged drives the gateway after this task. When not converged, currentParams and optimizerState are updated for the next iteration. When converged, optimalParams, bestPartition, and bestCutWeight hold the final result.
properties.value: = {converged: response.body.converged, convergenceReason: if response.body.converged then response.body.convergence_reason else null, iteration: response.body.iteration, optimizerState: if response.body.converged then {} else response.body.optimizer_state, currentParams: if response.body.converged then response.body.optimal_params else response.body.next_params, optimalParams: response.body.optimal_params, objectiveValue: response.body.objective_value, bestPartition: response.body.best_partition, bestCutWeight: response.body.best_cut_weight}

properties.label: Error Expression
properties.description: FEEL expression to map sidecar HTTP errors to BPMN errors
